scope: Static public official CLI v1.9.1 source inspection, not a live-server proof. Actual owned listener checks remain mandatory.
observations: The CLI command passes its --ip value into devserver StartOptions.FrontendIP and supplies separate HTTP and metrics ports.
The devserver constructs the metrics listener address from FrontendIP and MetricsPort.
Its frontend and internal RPC configurations use FrontendIP as BindOnIP; frontend configuration also sets the explicit HTTP port.
The CLI maps localhost to127.0.0.1; the H1 command instead passes the literal127.0.0.1.
H1 still checks actual owned TCP listener addresses at runtime and fails if an observed server listener is non-loopback.

binary_binding.limitation: Source observations plus release/binary hashes establish the reviewed launch configuration basis; they are not a reproducible source-to-binary build attestation.
